content: Yesuusa Shitto Tiyida Maccasiw
Paasika bonchiya gallasape usupun gallas sinthatidi, Yesuusi hayqope denthida Alaazari de7iya gutaa, Bitaane bis.
He bessan enti iyaw kaho giigisidosona. Alaazari Yesuusara issife gayta bolla uttidashin, Marti entana imatawusu.
Mayraama nardoose geetetiya daro al7o geeshsha shitto ehada Yesuusa tohuwa tiyasu. Ba binaanan iya tohuwa quchasu; keetha ubbay shitto sawon tonku gis.
Shin Yesuusa tamaaretape issoy, Yesuusa aathidi immanaysi, Asqoroota Yihuda,
“Ayis ha shittoy heedzu xeetu dinaaren bayzetidi, miishey manqotas imetennee?” yaagis.
I kayso gidida gisho hessa gisipe attishin, manqotas qadhetidi gibeenna. I miishe karxiita oykeysa gidiya gisho ubba wode iyape baw ekees.
Yesuusi, “Iya baw de7iyaba ta moogo gallasaas minjida gisho iyo aggaagite.
Manqoti ubba wode hintera daana, shin taani ubba wode hintera de7ike” yaagis.
He wode daro asay Yesuusi Bitaanen de7eysa si7idi yaa bidosona. Enti Yesuusa xalaala gidonashin, I hayqope denthida Alaazaraka be7anaw bidosona.
Hessa gisho, kahine halaqati Alaazaraka qassi wodhanaw maqetidosona.
Ayis giiko, Alaazara gaason daro Ayhudeti entana ixidi Yesuusa ammanoosona.
Gita Bonchon Yerusalaame Geluwa
Wontetha gallas Paasika bonchiya bessaa yida daro asay Yesuusi Yerusalaame beysa si7idi,
Zamba haythi ekidi iya mokanaw keyidosona. Banta qaala dhoqu oothidi,
yaagidosona.
Geeshsha Maxaafan,

content.text: Heko, ne Kawoy hare mara bolla uttidi yees”

content: geetetidayada Yesuusi hare mari demmidi iya toggis.
Yesuusa tamaareti hessa kase akeekibokona. Shin Yesuusi bonchetidaape guye enti hessa ubbaa akeekidosona. Hessi ubbay Geeshsha Maxaafay gidaysada hanis.
Yesuusi Alaazara duufope xeegidi, hayqope denthida wode iyara de7iya daro asay Yesuusaba markatidosona.
Daro asay iya mokanaw keyday, I he malaatata oothidaysa si7ida gishosa.
Hessa gisho, Farsaaweti issoy issuwako, “Nu aykoka oothanaw danda7onnaysa be7ite; dere ubbay iya kaallees” yaagidosona.
Paasika bonchiya gallas goyinnanaw Yerusalaame bidaysata giddon issi issi Girike asati de7oosona.
Enti Galila biittan Beetesayda katamaape yida Filphoosako bidi, “Godaw, nuuni Yesuusa be7anaw koyoos” yaagidi woossidosona.
Filphoosi bidi Indiriyasas odin nam7ay bidi, Yesuusas odidosona.
Yesuusi entako, “Asa Na7ay, bonchetiya wodey gakis.
Taani hintew tuma odayis; issi giste ayfey biittan wodhidi wooqonna ixiko barka attees. Shin he giste ayfey wooqiko daro ayfe ayfees.
Ba shempuwa dosiya oonika dhaysees; ba shempuwa ha alamiyan ixiya oonika merinaa de7os ashshees.
Taani de7iyasuwan taara daana mela taw oothanaw koyiya oonika tana kaallanaw bessees. Taw oothiya oonaka ta Aaway bonchana.
“Ha77i ta shempoy daro un7etis; yaatin woygo? ‘Ta Aawaw, tana ha saatepe ashsharki’ yaago? Akay, taani yiday waaye ekanaasa.
Ta Aawaw, ne sunthaa boncha” yaagis. He wode salope, “Taani ta sunthaa bonchas; zaaradaka bonchana” giya qaalay yis.
He bessan eqida daro asay he qaala si7idi, “Hessi dada” yaagidosona. Harati qassi, “Kiitanchoy iyaw odis” yaagidosona.
Yesuusi zaaridi entako, “Ha qaalay hinte gisho yisipe attishin, ta gisho gidenna.
Ha alamey pirdetiya wodey ha77i; ha alamiya haareysi ha77i kare holetana.
Qassi taani sa7ape dhoqu oosetida wode asa ubbaa taako ehana” yaagis.
I hessa giday ay mela hayqo hayqaneko entaw qoncisanaasa.
Daro asay zaaridi, “Nu higgey Kiristoosi merinaw de7eysa odees. Yaatin, neeni woygada, ‘Asa Na7ay dhoqu gaanaw bessees’ gay? ‘I, Asa Na7ay oonee?’ ” yaagidosona.
Yesuusi, “Poo7oy hintera guutha wode gam7ana. Hintew dhumonna mela poo7oy de7ishin, poo7uwan hemetite. Dhuman hemetiya asi aw biyako erenna.
Poo7o nayta gidana mela poo7oy de7ishin poo7uwa ammanite” yaagis. Yesuusi hessa odetidaape guye bidi entafe geemmis.
I hessa mela malaatata enta sinthan oothinka ammanibookona.
Nabiya Isayaasi,
Gidaysi tuma gidana mela enti iya ammanibookona.
Qassika Isayaasi,

content.text: enti Xoossaako simmin, I enta pathonna mela,

content: gida gisho enti ammananaw danda7ibookona.
Isayaasi hessa giday, Yesuusa bonchuwa be7ida gishonne iyabaa odida gishosa.
Gidikoka, Ayhudeta halaqatapeka daroti Yesuusa ammanidosona. Shin Farsaaweti bantana Ayhudeta Woosa Keethafe kessoosona gidi yayyida gisho ammanida gidi qoncen markatibookona.
Hessa enti oothiday, Xoossan eretanaysafe aathidi asan eretanaysa dosida gishosa.
Yesuusi ba qaala dhoqu oothidi, “Tana ammaniya oonika tana kiittidaysaka ammaneesipe attishin, ta xalaala ammanena.
Tana be7iya oonika tana kiittidaysaka be7ees.
Tana ammaniya ubbay dhuman doonna mela taani poo7o gidada alamiya yas.
Ta qaala si7idi kiitetonna oonaka taani pirdike. Ayis giiko, taani alamiya ashshanaw yasipe attishin, pirdanaw yabiike.
Tana ixeysanne ta qaala ekonna oonaka pirdeysi de7ees. Taani odida qaalay wursetha gallas he uraa pirdana.
Ayis giiko, taani hessa taape odike, shin tana kiitida ta Aaway taani gaanaysanne odanaysa kiittis.
Qassi iya kiitay merinaa de7o gideysa taani erayis. Hessa gisho, taani odeysi ta Aaway tana oda gidaysa” yaagis.
